text:
maria (pm): Quick sync — we just got another ask: large enterprise wants model pinning + rollout controls surfaced in the Console. Sales says demoability is a gating factor. Product question: do we push API-first (offer programmatic pin/rollout) or prioritize Console work? Looking for RICE-ish tradeoffs and launch criteria.

sam (eng): +1 API-first as the least friction to ship. Backend hooks for pin/rollout already mostly there; API endpoints ~1-2 weeks to do properly, Console screens ~4-6w for UX + QA. API-first also makes Dedicated/private customers happy.

jess (devex): API-first lowers developer friction but I echo the demo risk — many buyers evaluate via Console. Could we do API-first plus a lightweight Console "control panel" (read-only + a single action) so sales can demo?

kevin (sales): Field notes: 3 RFPs specifically call out an admin UI. One strategic prospect told me they won't progress without a Console demo showing rollouts and audit logs. API workaround okay but not ideal for procurement. Impact is high. :warning:

sam (eng): Quick back-of-envelope RICE to compare options (very rough):
```
API-only: R=3 I=6 C=0.6 E=1 => RICE=(3*6*0.6)/1 = 10.8
API + light-console: R=4 I=8 C=0.5 E=3 => RICE=(4*8*0.5)/3 = 5.3
Full-console: R=5 I=9 C=0.4 E=6 => RICE=(5*9*0.4)/6 = 3.0
```
Notes: Reach scaled up for console because it unlocks more buyers, confidence drops because UI effort > unknowns. Effort is person-months-ish.

maria (pm): This is helpful. Proposal for sequenced plan:
- Ship API contract + SDK sample (server-side + webhooks) as Phase 1 (target: 2 wks).
- Parallel: ship a read-only Console view (no heavy UX) that displays pinning + rollout status and audit logs so sales can demo (target: 3 wks).
- Phase 2: full Console controls (can toggle rollout, create canary rules) if adoption/demand justifies.

Launch criteria (suggested):
- API: published OpenAPI contract, SDK example, integration test covering pin->rollout path.
- Console preview: deployed in staging, read-only view shows real data for customers on Dedicated/Private.
- One reference customer onboarded via API or Console preview.
- Metrics: rollout API latency <200ms median, audit-log ingest <1s for UI, error rate <0.5%.
- Security: KMS keys verified for Private deployments, audit log retention policy documented.

jess (devex): I'll draft quickstart + two language samples and a step-by-step demo script for sales. Also add a pre-baked Postman/Insomnia collection.

kevin (sales): I'll push prospects a "Console preview" demo slot and mark the three deals as contingent on preview availability. Can we aim demo-ready in 3 weeks?

sam (eng): Agree to owners: API endpoints — sam + infra; Console read-only — nina (frontend) + sam for API. I'll open tickets with estimates. Can we set canary rollout plan?

maria (pm): Canary plan: 10% of internal traffic -> 10% pilot customers -> ramp to 100% if metrics good for 72h. If regression, automatic rollback to last stable model variant.

ci-bot: CI passed for branch feature/rollout-api (build 482). :white_check_mark:

maria (pm): OK — action items: sam to create tickets & estimates by EOD, jess to produce quickstart by mid-next-week, kevin to schedule demos. We'll reconvene Wed for sign-off. Thanks all. :tada:
